scope: Targeted citation repair acceptance only; three frozen questions x two retrieval modes. No release or merge authorization.
reviewer: Codex model review; no independent human review or paid LLM judge
metric_definition: 20 required metrics per arm and overall; candidate retrieval and final supplied evidence are distinct. Quality results are model assessments under the unchanged retained rubric.

Final evidence coverage.method: Unchanged 0/0.5/1 rubric; Codex model review against frozen original-page facts and actual supplied sources. Errors count zero for requested points.

literal_anchor_diagnostic.method: Same original page anchor spans including supplements; equivalent facts elsewhere may miss. This does not replace semantic evidence review.

Answer correctness.method: Unchanged 0/0.5/1 rubric; Codex model review against frozen original-page facts and actual supplied sources. Errors count zero for requested points.

Answer completeness.method: Unchanged 0/0.5/1 rubric; Codex model review against frozen original-page facts and actual supplied sources. Errors count zero for requested points.

Faithfulness.population: Factual claim groups in completed answers; errors and claim-free refusals excluded
Faithfulness.method: Unchanged 0/0.5/1 model review of factual paragraphs/bullets against actual context and specifically cited sources; syntactic citation IDs are insufficient.
Faithfulness.aggregation: micro mean over reviewed claim groups

Citation support.method: Unchanged 0/0.5/1 model review of factual paragraphs/bullets against actual context and specifically cited sources; syntactic citation IDs are insufficient.

Answer relevance.method: 1 for addressing the requested topic including relevant refusal; 0 for error/wrong document.

appropriate.reason: No unanswerable questions in this targeted workload.

Abstention.method: Full refusals only. Failed requests are errors, not abstentions. No unanswerable behavior validated here.

First-answer-delta latency.population: Completed SSE requests in this subset
First-answer-delta latency.method: Client perf_counter from HTTP start to first nonempty answer delta / SSE close. Server startup excluded; request queue/provider waiting included; deterministic replies retained.

unsuccessful_requests.method: Retain observed failed/incomplete request timing separately from successful latency; absent first deltas are not replaced with completion time.

Complete-response latency.population: Completed SSE requests in this subset
Complete-response latency.method: Client perf_counter from HTTP start to first nonempty answer delta / SSE close. Server startup excluded; request queue/provider waiting included; deterministic replies retained.

unsuccessful_requests.method: Retain observed failed/incomplete request timing separately from successful latency; absent first deltas are not replaced with completion time.

Stage latency.population: Observed calls including failed downstream validation
Stage latency.method: SDK boundaries include provider/network waits; retrieval entrypoint and packing diagnostic timers; final traces provide unique per-query rerank/embedding observations. Per-stage sample counts are explicit. Startup excluded; first request may include local lazy loading; no isolated cold/warm attribution.

unavailable.search_fusion_separate: No dedicated search/fusion wall timer; not inferred by subtracting unlike boundaries.
unavailable.provider_queue_separate: Provider does not expose queue duration.
unavailable.model_loading_separate: No separately instrumented lazy model load duration; may be included in first retrieval.

text-embedding-3-small.output_tokens_reason: Embedding calls produce vectors, not generated text.
text-embedding-3-small.cached_input_tokens_reason: At least one provider response omits this usage field.

billed_cost.reason: Provider billing statement unavailable; no fabricated or estimated bill.

local_compute.device: Apple Silicon; BGE reranker on MPS; resolved-runtime.json records exact configuration.

Token usage and cost.population: Actual SDK terminal responses for selected requests
Token usage and cost.method: Preserved provider usage, including planner/assessor calls that later failed validation; no token estimation. Model identifiers are provider-resolved.

local_evidence_tokens.method: Production cl100k_base exact context counts; not provider billing. Error final candidate contexts may never reach generation.

value.saved_source_comparison: Exact source payloads, excluding only saved-history file_deleted lifecycle flag.

Reliability.method: Actual SSE terminal status, SDK errors and saved-history equality. SDK retries disabled; one request per pair. Completion alone does not establish correctness.

Concurrency and throughput.method: Each pass has the same six-request workload. Command wall includes both arms, history/client I/O and setup; arm contributions add to overall throughput. No load-capacity or causal speed claim.

Ingestion and index.reason: Answer-only pass: no upload/parser/reembedding/update/delete workload. The baseline preparation and current exact clone are documented separately in their preparation artifacts.
